reuse.why: Reuses setBudget, getSheetValue, hasSavedTemplates, batchMessages and the sum-amount sheet cell, but repeats the category-selection query and skip rules rather than sharing them (no shared selection helper exists in the tree to call).

duplication.why: The category SQL query plus the income/template skip loop is a verbatim fifth copy of the block already repeated in setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler type/registration and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: Simple and readable, but adds another copy of the 'which categories' rule so any future change to it must be made in five places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared category-selection abstraction exists in the tree; the change uses the existing setBudget/getSheetValue/hasSavedTemplates helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: The selection block in setLastMonthSpending (actions.ts) is a plain verbatim copy of the one in set3MonthAvg, not disguised.
